summary: Diff adds two eval cases for a new adversarial-review-2 skill: a Redis session-cache design and a follow-the-sun on-call plan, each with planted flaws and graded expectations (severity ranking, failure scenarios, retest checks, verdicts). It adds the two fixture documents and edits the existing adversarial-review SKILL.md description to route severity-graded or retest-loop requests to adversarial-review-2.

claims.text: Eval 1 expects sizing math 200k x 40KB = 8GB equal to cluster free space; fixture states those numbers.
Eval 1 expects KEYS-based invalidation flagged; fixture invalidates via KEYS session:*:pricing on shared cluster.
Eval 2 expects timezone gap: Krakow 08:00-20:00 CET = 02:00-14:00 ET leaves 20:00-02:00 ET uncovered.
Eval 2 expects US-only IC pool flagged; fixture says IC pool is all US-based.
adversarial-review SKILL.md now defers severity-graded findings and retest loops to adversarial-review-2.
Eval 2 mentions a 'zero-overnight-pages goal'; fixture's success metric is zero overnight pages within first month.

risks.note: CET-to-ET offset is 6 hours only outside DST mismatch weeks; eval hardcodes it.
Description references adversarial-review-2 skill; its SKILL.md is not in this chunk, so existence unverified.
evals.json lacks trailing newline; may matter for tooling or linting.
